topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I opened my email this morning, expecting the usual, and there it was—an invitation to revisit my past. The college admissions board had just released a few selections from the previous year's applications as examples for prospective students. Among them, to my astonishment, was my essay. I read through it, word by word, as if seeing it for the first time. The thoughts, the struggles, the moments that shaped my words—that was all me, capturing a piece of who I was and what I aspired to be. It’s a little surreal to see my personal journey laid out like that, a guide for others. I guess, in a way, it’s like passing the torch, showing others that they too can articulate their dreams and make them real.
